fato_historico: 1916: Jeannette Rankin is the first woman elected to the United States Congress.
energia_do_dia: The universe invites you to step into your power and chart a new path. Much like the pioneers who shattered barriers to lead the way, you may find that today is an excellent time to champion your own vision. Consider how your voice can inspire others as you pursue your boldest dreams with optimism and grace.
frase_do_dia: Your courage today paves the road for the wonders of your bright tomorrow.
significado_numero: Represents the dawn of a new cycle and individual leadership.
conselho: Trust your intuition and take that first bold step toward your grandest goal.
